issue.title: Type and go: start a conversation or terminal from Home with no project, and fix Simple/Advanced defaulting
acceptanceCriteria: **AC-1 (W1):** `npx vitest run src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/simple/uiMode.test.ts` passes, with 4 tests named as in W1.

**AC-3 (W3):** `grep -c "<TalkItThrough" src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/simple/SimpleHomePage.tsx` prints `0`. `grep -c "<HomeComposer" src/dashboard/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/simple/SimpleHomePage.tsx` prints 1 for each. The Playwright spec `tests/home-type-and-go.spec.ts` passes.

**AC-4 (W4):** `grep -n "hasUnscopedConversations &&" src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx` matches nothing. `grep -n "openTypedPane('terminal')" src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Stage/ProjectHome.tsx` matches nothing. The terminals route test, `ProjectHome` test and `useDefaultDeckSelection` test pass. `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh` passes.
**AC-6 (W6):** `grep -rn "repository-root-elsewhere" src/` matches nothing. The four new `create-intent.test.ts` cases and the suggestions route test pass.

**AC-7 (W7):** `AddProjectDialog.test.tsx` passes, including the case `only resolve and create routes receive POSTs`. That case mocks `fetch`, drives every dialog path (folder, non-git, nested, clone, create, suggestion), and asserts every `POST` targets only `/api/projects/resolve` or `/api/projects` (plus the existing create-job poll/cancel/reconcile routes already used by `useProjectCreateInten

**AC-9 (W9):** `smartField.test.ts` passes. The workspace create tests for `project-missing` and `branchQuery` pass. `grep -n "Multiple projects are registered" src/lib/workspaces/create.ts` still matches (the ambiguous case is unchanged), and `grep -n "project-missing" src/lib/workspaces/create.ts` matches.

**AC-10 (W10):** `first-run-checks.test.ts` and `system-prerequisites.test.ts` pass. `curl -s localhost:3011/api/prerequisites | jq '.auth, .backend, .memory'` prints three non-null objects on a running dev dashboard.
**AC-12 (W12):** the install-prereqs and doctor tests pass. `scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt` has a row for `doctor.ts` if it grew.
